liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Drifter in the Dark** (3 other sources): Dean played acoustic guitar while Gene played electric guitar and harmonica; Dean on acoustic guitar, Gene on electric guitar and harmonica [1][2][3]
- **Demon Sweat** (2 other sources): Gene played keyboards on this song [1][3]
- **I Dont Want It** (1 other source): Dean played acoustic guitar on this song [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Dont Get to Close**: back after 126 archived shows (3459 days); rare: 7 archived performances [6]
- **Among His Tribe**: rare: 5 archived performances [6]
- **Kim Smoltz**: rare: 14 archived performances [6]
- **Cold and Wet**: rare: 9 archived performances [6]
- **Old Queen Cole**: back after 63 archived shows (2418 days) [6]
- **Pumpin for the Man**: rare: 10 archived performances [6]
- **I Got to Put the Hammer Down**: back after 103 archived shows (3285 days) [6]
- **The Stallion pt4**: back after 47 archived shows (2059 days); rare: 14 archived performances [6]

## The recordings

- **ween2017-07-14.km40.flac24** (recommended): source not stated; 29 songs; 132 min [1]
- **ween2017-07-14.km40.flac16**: source not stated; 29 songs; 132 min [2]
- **ween2017-07-14.ck930.flac24**: source not stated; 29 songs; 133 min [3]
- **ween2017-07-14.ck930.flac16**: source not stated; 29 songs; 133 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **ween2017-07-14.km40.flac24**: taped by Melissa Fry; source: km40 > 722 (24/96) [1]. Also: Recorded with ORTF microphone placement, plus FOB, DFC, KFC and AARP in the location notes; 24-bit FLAC from km40 mics [1]
- **ween2017-07-14.km40.flac16**: taped by Melissa Fry; source: km40 > 722 (24/96) [2]. Also: 16-bit FLAC from km40 mics, with ORTF, FOB, DFC, KFC and AARP in the location notes; gear loaned by Tim Fraley [2]
- **ween2017-07-14.ck930.flac24**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: Beyerdynamic CK930 > Naiant IPA > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (@ 24/48) [3]
- **ween2017-07-14.ck930.flac16**: taped by Mike B; transferred by Mike B; source: Beyerdynamic CK930 > Naiant IPA > Sound Devices MixPre-6 (@ 24/48) [4]
